# PCP-7766 (target v1.13.4 = canonical/main 25b67ac, local-only tag) — proposed at plan, approved at Gate 1
# reviewer-applied (PCP-7766 plan-review r1): 9eac332/38bfeac/ca50d75 touch ONLY overlay SOURCES
# They were REGEN only because conf GENERATED_PATHS matches spectro/base|spectro/global. Same reasoning as
# 6e1d824 (F2 PICK): overlays are source. Left as REGENERATE they are never cherry-picked, so spectro/run.sh
# re-derives spectro/generated WITHOUT: ENABLE_WEBHOOKS=false on the base (controller) Deployment (9eac332;
# without it a34d16a's split runs the per-cluster pod webhook-only = no CK8s reconcilers), global
# (ca50d75). Shared rules.tsv agrees: `path spectro/ -> PICK`. Fork-only files, apply in S order -> clean.
# 36a7693 REGENERATE execute-time requirement (reviewer note): the Makefile half is superseded (T already
# CONTROLLER_GEN_VER v0.21.0). spectro/generated is NOT produced by `make generate manifests` — the executor
# must run `mkdir -p spectro/generated && touch spectro/generated/.gitkeep && (cd spectro && ./run.sh)`
# (kustomize) AFTER the overlay PICKs, and commit the 4 files palette vendorcrd-sync pulls by URL
